correctness.rationale: Self-contained parity count by Lucas theorem and a binomial local bound give annealed F_N <= N^{-1/2+o(1)}; an entire time slice changes F_N by at most 4/N, giving McDiarmid tail <=2 exp(-N u^2/8). With u=N^{-1/2+delta}, Borel--Cantelli yields the one-environment almost-sure bound for every delta>0. The conditional martingale bracket converges uniformly in probability and the bounded jump martingale FCLT supplies the asserted Brownian limit. All quantifiers, parameter assumptions, boundary n=0 and infinite-time limits have been checked. The standalone exact checker passes 84,143 assertions for N<=5; finite diagnostics do not establish the asymptotic theorem.

value.rationale: The result resolves the explicitly open quenched upgrade of a concrete 2026 annealed Brownian theorem for the one-factor Markov cardinality recoding, preserving its full nonidentical uniformly elliptic parameter class. It supplies an almost-sure conditional quadratic-variation rate, not an arbitrary finite slice or a restatement of the general martingale CLT.
